notes: The 'My Home, My Singapore' card game for seniors (DBS Foundation and SUSS partnership) was a health-oriented community activity and was not counted as creative work. The Garena co-branded gaming card and directors' outside arts roles (LaSalle, University of the Arts) are not company creative activities. SGD 500 million in unsecured MSME loans, SME banking, India Priority Sector Lending and SecureFX/GlobeSend tools were treated as serving small businesses, not enabling them. The 26 Businesses for Impact catalysed and the SGD 160 million committed since 2024 (part of up to SGD 1 billion over 10 years) support E1 and E9 but were not separately recorded to avoid double counting. People of Purpose literacy outreach to more than 100,000 people overlaps with E2. Group Audit carried out a 'Special Review of DBS Foundation as requested by the Board'; no findings are disclosed. Some source quotes contain line breaks or double spaces that were normalized to single spaces.
